digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate (orchestrator, det_floor.py, passes.py, criteria_routing.json, review_kernel)
propositions: Recommendations R1-R7 from the task-decomposition SOTA report must be validated experimentally with eval gates before implementation, except R6 which ships first as a deterministic rendering with validator compliance.

The original batch-eval-gated strategy was replaced by an advisory-first approach where R1/R3/R4 ship in advisory posture (never blocking), pass a bounded sanity check, and are auto-monitored by standing dogfood effectiveness recording (d8a5) with a documented advisory-to-blocking promotion gate.

E1's finding-adjudication corpus and inter-rater kappa gate were descoped due to tool-less/plan-truncated contamination; E2/E3 expensive LLM batch baselines were permanently rejected and superseded by story d8a5's zero-LLM standing recorder.

R2/R3/R4 land serially in any order touching criteria_routing.json and review_kernel, coordinated after the floor-split story to avoid file conflicts; R2 is actually a det_floor.py change (DET floor check), not a criteria_routing.json change.

All landed criteria/rubric changes are incorporated directly into the packaged registry with no config-flag or overlay gating; new criteria enter at advisory posture first where child gate terms specify, with demotion to advisory when blocking-FP proxy exceeds 10% over a trailing window.
